summary.text: Todd Warner is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 92 who has served since November 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a farmer.

paragraphs.text: Todd Warner was born in Chapel Hill, Tennessee, and graduated from Forrest High School in 1989.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as farming.
He succeeded Thomas R. Tillis in House District 92 and assumed office on November 3, 2020.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Education Administration and Education Instruction committees.

Ballotpedia also reports that Warner ran in the Republican primary for Tennessee's 9th Congressional District and lost on August 6, 2026, while advancing from the Republican primary for his House seat.
In a Ballotpedia survey for that congressional race, he described himself as an eighth-generation Tennessee farmer, small business owner and lifelong conservative.
